Summary: Build a Fixed-Income terminal demo app (design-system-demo)
Description: Scaffold a new reference application that showcases the design system as a realistic FI trading terminal with a component gallery, registered in the workspace on port 5310.
Acceptance Criteria: App boots on port 5310 and is registered as a workspace member; renders an app shell with TopBar and tab navigation; deterministic seed data drives all widgets; build and typecheck pass.
Implementation Summary: Scaffolded the app, added FI data types with deterministic seeds and formatters, a pure applyTick ticking reducer with tests, and a useTickingStore interval hook. Added grid theme, theme-mode hook, ThemeToggle and CodeBlock helpers, then the TopBar + tab navigation shell.

Summary: Design System gallery tab with full component showcase
Description: Provide an interactive Design System tab that documents foundations (palette, typography) and demonstrates every shipped component grouped by category, with a completeness gate ensuring no component is undocumented.
Acceptance Criteria: Tab renders foundations + a categorized component gallery; a completeness gate fails the build if a registered component lacks a showcase entry; sections cover buttons, inputs, selection, overlays, navigation, data display, feedback, layout and charts.
Implementation Summary: Built a showcase framework (types, ComponentDemo, registry + completeness gate), added palette/typography/foundations/overview sections, then populated showcase entries across all component categories until the gallery was complete.

Summary: FI terminal tabs: Market, Orders, Analytics, Risk, Research
Description: Deliver the core trading-terminal tabs: Market (blotter, watchlist, book, chart, ticket), Orders (blotter, order entry, RFQ), Analytics + Risk (charts, KPIs, exposure), and Research.
Acceptance Criteria: Each tab renders with live ticking data and design-system tokens only; charts, KPIs and blotters populate from seed state; no hardcoded colours.
Implementation Summary: Implemented Market, Orders, Analytics+Risk and Research tabs as composed views over the shared ticking store.

Summary: Dock-manager workspace for the FI demo (floating + docked panels)
Description: Replace static tabs with a dock-manager foundation supporting per-tab layouts, floating windows, and Save/Reset layout so users can rearrange the terminal.
Acceptance Criteria: Panels can be docked, floated, saved and reset per tab; Market dock is wired to live state; Trade Ticket and RFQ Workbench open as floating windows; layout persists across Save/Reset.
Implementation Summary: Added dock-manager helpers, registry and per-tab layouts; wired the Market dock to live state and added floating Trade Ticket + RFQ Workbench plus Save/Reset. Migrated Orders and Design System into dock widgets and removed the superseded tabs/panels.

Summary: Expanded FI data model, trade ticket, order book and RFQ workbench
Description: Add a realistic FI data model and the interactive trading surfaces: a dealer-depth order book with recent prints, an FI trade ticket, and an RFQ workbench backed by a state machine.
Acceptance Criteria: Order book shows dealer depth + recent prints with issuer header; trade ticket validates and submits with focus-ring CTA; RFQ workbench drives a documented state machine; all under 80 LOC/function and token-compliant.
Implementation Summary: Expanded the FI data model + DemoStateProvider, built the dealer-depth order book, FI trade ticket (with extracted CtaButton helper), and the RFQ workbench + state machine.

Summary: FI-terminal visual parity for RFQ, Trade Ticket and Orders
Description: Polish the RFQ, trade ticket and Orders surfaces to match the fi-terminal reference for elegance, spacing, and conviction Buy/Sell affordances.
Acceptance Criteria: RFQ/ticket support close, fit-to-content, conviction Buy/Sell and sane spreads; Orders, RFQ and ticket visually match the fi-terminal reference; Market tab layout matches reference.
Implementation Summary: Reworked RFQ/ticket interactions (close, fit, conviction, spreads), matched fi-terminal styling across the three surfaces, and restructured the Market tab layout to the reference.

Summary: MarketsGrid Lab developer-onboarding rework
Description: Rework the MarketsGrid Lab into a developer-onboarding experience with a Home landing tab, a grouped collapsible sidebar nav with filter, and an Inspector drawer (What/Why, Try, Config, Props) per feature.
Acceptance Criteria: Home tab is the default with hero, mount example, mental-model cards and feature map; sidebar replaces the horizontal tab strip with grouped, filterable, collapsible nav; Inspector drawer renders What/Why, Try, Config and Props derived from each feature config.
Implementation Summary: Added a feature-guide registry with shared base props, derived Inspector config blocks from LabFeatureConfig, built the InspectorDrawer and mounted it under the grid, added the grouped sidebar nav and the Home landing tab, then made the sidebar the default layout.

Summary: Grid column selector dialog + consolidated View menu
Description: Add a column selector dialog and consolidate column/view actions into a single View menu to declutter the grid toolbar.
Acceptance Criteria: Column selector dialog lets users show/hide and reorder columns; the View menu groups previously scattered toolbar actions; toolbar is visibly less cluttered.
Implementation Summary: Added the column selector dialog and a consolidated View menu.

Summary: Drag columns from the Columns tool panel onto the grid
Description: Allow users to drag columns directly from the Columns tool panel into the grid to add them.
Acceptance Criteria: Dragging a column from the Columns tool panel adds it to the grid at the drop position.
Implementation Summary: Enabled drag-from-tool-panel-to-grid behaviour.

Summary: Auto Format and field-format catalog for the grid
Description: Add an Auto Format toolbar button backed by a field-format catalog so columns are formatted automatically by inferred type, with K/M magnitude scaling.
Acceptance Criteria: Auto Format button infers and applies formats per column; a field-format catalog drives matching (incl. K/M magnitude scaling); manual formats override auto formats; Auto Format is native to the formatting system.
Implementation Summary: Added the field-format catalog + Auto Format toolbar button, added K/M magnitude scaling and Soundex matching to the catalog, made Auto Format native to the formatting system, and let manual format override an auto-formatted column.

Summary: Formatter toolbar usability overhaul + pop-out inspector
Description: Redesign the formatter toolbar for usability: a value readout, decimals control, search, category-tabbed selector, prominent currency/tick selectors, and a pop-out formatter panel redesigned as a flat inspector.
Acceptance Criteria: Formatter toolbar shows a readout, decimals and search; selector is category-tabbed with prominent currency/tick options; the pop-out panel is a flat inspector with templates in a Select, dismisses popovers on outside click, and supports touch/pen in the colour picker.
Implementation Summary: Added formatter toolbar usability features, a category-tabbed selector, prominent currency/tick selectors, and a popped-out panel redesigned as a flat inspector with assorted layout and dismissal fixes; added touch/pen support to the colour picker.

Summary: Clear buttons fire immediately (no confirm dialog)
Description: Make formatter Clear buttons apply immediately instead of prompting a confirm dialog.
Acceptance Criteria: Clicking a Clear button clears immediately with no confirmation step.
Implementation Summary: Removed the confirm dialog so Clear fires immediately.

Summary: Relative trailing-window date filters in the stream-safe floating filter
Description: Add relative trailing-window date filters (e.g. last N days) to the stream-safe floating filter so date filtering stays correct under live data.
Acceptance Criteria: Floating filter offers relative trailing-window date options that remain stable as new ticks stream in.
Implementation Summary: Implemented relative trailing-window date filters in the stream-safe floating filter.

Summary: Grid cell context menu: Settings + Remove from Grid
Description: Add Settings and Remove from Grid items to the cell context menu.
Acceptance Criteria: Right-clicking a cell offers Settings and Remove from Grid actions that work as labelled.
Implementation Summary: Added the two context-menu items.

Summary: Richer default GridOptions, status/side bar, and per-column Multi Filter
Description: Update default grid options to enable the status bar, side bar, richer grouping/selection defaults, and a default per-column Multi Filter.
Acceptance Criteria: New grids show status bar and side bar by default with richer grouping/selection; columns default to Multi Filter.
Implementation Summary: Updated default GridOptions and the default per-column Multi Filter; enabled status bar, side bar and richer grouping/selection defaults.

Summary: Persist customizer settings to IndexedDB on panel Save
Description: Persist grid customizer settings to IndexedDB when the user saves a panel so they survive reloads.
Acceptance Criteria: Saving a customizer panel writes settings to IndexedDB; settings are restored on reload.
Implementation Summary: Wired customizer Save to persist into IndexedDB.

Summary: Export/import column defs as JSON in the Columns tab
Description: Let users export and re-import grid column definitions as JSON from the provider editor Columns tab.
Acceptance Criteria: Columns tab can export current column defs to JSON and import a JSON file to apply them.
Implementation Summary: Added JSON export/import of column defs in the Columns tab.

Summary: OpenFin grid-to-grid colour linking with selection sharing
Description: Enable OpenFin colour-based context linking between grids so selecting a row in one grid shares selection to colour-linked grids, with notifications.
Acceptance Criteria: Grids can be colour-linked in OpenFin; selecting a row broadcasts to linked grids; notifications surface link events; diagnostics are gated behind a debug flag.
Implementation Summary: Implemented OpenFin grid-to-grid colour linking with selection sharing + notifications, enabled it on the star-demo blotter, and gated grid-link console diagnostics behind contextLink.debug.

Summary: Host-data fan-out workers, STOMP recovery, and idle provider teardown
Description: Improve streaming reliability and performance: fan-out SharedWorkers, STOMP reconnect/recovery, blotter hardening, idle provider teardown, and columnar snapshots.
Acceptance Criteria: Multiple consumers fan out from workers without duplicate connections; STOMP reconnects and recovers cleanly; idle providers are torn down to free memory; snapshots default to columnar; no lifecycle leaks remain.
Implementation Summary: Added fan-out workers, STOMP recovery and blotter hardening; added idle provider teardown and streaming performance fixes; defaulted snapshots to columnar; ran memory audits and fixed lifecycle leaks.

Summary: Consolidate host-config into a single ConfigManager + provider persistence
Description: Collapse the config service layer into one ConfigManager and persist provider selection together with profiles.
Acceptance Criteria: A single ConfigManager replaces the prior service split; selecting a provider persists with its profile (with OCC retry + co-save); behaviour is unchanged for consumers.
Implementation Summary: Collapsed the config service into one ConfigManager and persisted provider selection with profiles via OCC retry + co-save.

Summary: Config Browser: backup-gated Reset to seed
Description: Add a Reset to seed action to the Config Browser, gated behind a backup so users can't lose config accidentally.
Acceptance Criteria: Reset to seed restores seed config only after a backup is taken; action is clearly labelled and reversible via the backup.
Implementation Summary: Added the backup-gated Reset to seed action.

Summary: Light theme retuned to VS Code Light Modern
Description: Retune the design-system light theme surfaces to match VS Code's Light Modern palette for a more familiar, refined light mode.
Acceptance Criteria: Light-mode surfaces match the Light Modern reference; all surfaces remain token-driven; dark mode unaffected.
Implementation Summary: Retuned light theme surfaces to the VS Code Light Modern palette.

Summary: Consolidate accent colour to canonical cyan
Description: Consolidate the accent colour to a single canonical cyan and retire the legacy --highlight token.
Acceptance Criteria: All accent usage resolves to the canonical cyan token; --highlight is removed with no orphaned references.
Implementation Summary: Consolidated accent to canonical cyan and retired --highlight.

Summary: Dark-mode AG Grid theming: selected-row tint and shared colour params
Description: Improve dark-mode AG Grid theming with a selected-row tint and shared grid colour params, and hide the column-resize handle in both themes.
Acceptance Criteria: Selected rows show a subtle dark-mode tint; AG Grid uses shared design-system colour params in dark mode; column-resize handle is hidden in both themes; snapshot tests updated.
Implementation Summary: Added the dark-mode selected-row tint (#73BBF626), applied shared grid colour params in AG Grid dark mode, hid the resize handle in both themes, and updated the agGrid params snapshot.

Summary: OpenFin dark-mode chrome perceptibility and theme sync
Description: Improve OpenFin dark-mode chrome: lighten the header for perceptibility, distinguish window borders, and sync tool-window theme with the dock toggle.
Acceptance Criteria: Dark-mode chrome header is perceptibly lighter; window borders are distinguishable; tool windows re-theme when the dock toggle flips.
Implementation Summary: Lightened the dark-mode chrome header, distinguished dark-mode window borders, and synced tool-window theme with the dock toggle.

Summary: Bind MarketsGrid caption to the OpenFin tab name
Description: Bind the grid caption to the OpenFin tab name and apply toolbar UX polish.
Acceptance Criteria: Grid caption reflects the OpenFin tab name and updates with it; toolbar UX polish applied.
Implementation Summary: Bound the caption to the OpenFin tab name and polished the toolbar.

Summary: Build apps from source and harden the monorepo
Description: Switch apps to build from source (drop tarball deps), exclude Angular from the pipeline, stabilise dependency ranges, and add lint/CI guardrails with boundary fixes and god-object decomposition.
Acceptance Criteria: Apps build/typecheck from package source with no @wellsfargo-starui tarball deps; Angular is excluded from build/typecheck/test/propagate; dependency ranges are stable; lint/CI guardrails enforce import boundaries; oversized god-objects are decomposed.
Implementation Summary: Moved apps to source builds and dropped tarball deps (Angular excluded), pinned stable dep ranges with standalone propagate, removed the stockflux demo, and hardened the monorepo with lint/CI guardrails, boundary fixes and god-object decomposition.

Summary: Stomp view server: high-frequency randomized ticks
Description: Make the STOMP view server emit realistic high-frequency ticks by randomizing currentPrice and pnl per tick, defaulting to 20k high-frequency.
Acceptance Criteria: Server randomizes currentPrice and pnl on each live tick; defaults to 20k high-frequency with a checked-in .env.
Implementation Summary: Randomized currentPrice + pnl per live tick and defaulted to 20k high-frequency with a checked-in .env.

Summary: Fix: layout-selector captions truncating to one character
Description: Grid layout-selector captions were truncating to a single character.
Acceptance Criteria: Layout-selector captions render in full without truncation.
Implementation Summary: Stopped the layout-selector captions truncating to one character.

Summary: Fix: align row selection with AG Grid 35 checkbox-less mode
Description: Row selection was misaligned after the AG Grid 35 move to checkbox-less selection mode.
Acceptance Criteria: Row selection behaves correctly under AG Grid 35 checkbox-less mode.
Implementation Summary: Aligned row selection with AG Grid 35 checkbox-less mode.

Summary: Fix: pin Playwright to 1.59.x and stop ViewMenu staying open
Description: Playwright version drift and the ViewMenu remaining open after selection caused e2e flakiness.
Acceptance Criteria: Playwright is pinned to 1.59.x; the ViewMenu closes after a selection; affected e2e specs pass.
Implementation Summary: Pinned Playwright to 1.59.x and stopped the ViewMenu keeping its menu open.

Summary: Fix: Auto Format right-aligning text columns via Soundex collision
Description: A Soundex collision caused Auto Format to right-align text columns as if numeric.
Acceptance Criteria: Text columns are no longer right-aligned by Auto Format; numeric detection is not triggered by Soundex collisions.
Implementation Summary: Stopped Auto Format right-aligning text columns via the Soundex collision.

Summary: Fix: infer date fields as dateString cellDataType
Description: Date fields were not being inferred with the dateString cellDataType in the provider editor.
Acceptance Criteria: Inferred date fields are assigned the dateString cellDataType.
Implementation Summary: Inferred date fields as dateString cellDataType.

Summary: Fix: Config Browser primary/danger button foregrounds
Description: Primary and danger buttons in the Config Browser had incorrect (white) foreground colours.
Acceptance Criteria: Primary and danger buttons use the correct token-driven foreground colours.
Implementation Summary: Corrected the primary/danger button foreground (was white).

Summary: Fix: dock-editor token aliases fully design-system derived
Description: Dock-editor token aliases were not 100% derived from the design system.
Acceptance Criteria: All dock-editor token aliases resolve from design-system tokens.
Implementation Summary: Made the dock-editor token aliases 100% design-system derived.

Summary: Fix: align demo apps with current design-system token vocabulary
Description: Demo apps used outdated design-system token names.
Acceptance Criteria: Demo apps reference the current token vocabulary with no orphaned token names.
Implementation Summary: Aligned demo apps with the current design-system token vocabulary.

Summary: Fix: theme mode shared so dock panels re-theme on toggle
Description: Dock panels and grids did not re-theme when the theme toggle flipped.
Acceptance Criteria: Toggling the theme re-themes all dock panels and grids immediately.
Implementation Summary: Shared theme mode so dock panels re-theme on toggle and made grids inherit data-ag-theme-mode from <html>.

Summary: Fix: Risk KPIs dock panel height and Orders badge clipping
Description: The Risk KPIs dock panel was too short and Orders status badge borders were clipping in AG Grid.
Acceptance Criteria: Risk KPIs panel has enough height to render its KPIs; Orders status badge borders are not clipped in AG Grid.
Implementation Summary: Gave the Risk KPIs dock panel enough height and stopped the Orders status badge borders clipping in AG Grid.

Summary: Fix: Design System right pane scrollable in dock panel
Description: The Design System right pane did not scroll when docked.
Acceptance Criteria: The Design System right pane scrolls within its dock panel.
Implementation Summary: Made the Design System right pane scrollable in the dock panel.

Summary: Fix: assorted FI demo correctness (P&L waterfall, OAS distribution, tokens, testids)
Description: Several FI demo correctness issues: incorrect OAS distribution and P&L waterfall, an invalid font-family syntax, as-any style casts, fragile testids, and a risk progress track not using a token.
Acceptance Criteria: Per-issuer OAS distribution and a true waterfall P&L render correctly; font-family syntax is valid; as-any style casts removed; testids are robust and correct; risk progress track uses --ds-primary-soft.
Implementation Summary: Fixed per-issuer OAS distribution, true waterfall P&L and font-family syntax; corrected float-* testids and dropped as-any casts with a robust Save; pointed the risk progress track at --ds-primary-soft; fixed valid tokens + issuer in the order-book header; corrected the PriceChartWidget testid.
